subject: [hw] T01 start: emulator test infrastructure
body: Read PLAN, WORKER_RULES, TASK, n2a32.h/n2elf.h. Building under gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu + emu/n2a32_trace.c: asmrun (llvm-mc -> object -> .text at 0x10000, sentinel udf #254), 48+ C kernels, 7 ARM build configs through V03 + n2a32_call, trace ring/file, 2M-case fuzz. Note: trace API beyond the three frozen hooks (attach/dump/set_elf) will live in gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/n2a32_trace.h since only emu/n2a32_trace.c is mine; ask hw-lead if it should move into include/. Blocked on V02 core and V03 loader for execution; harness will report a clear FAIL until their sources appear.
